title: The Best Burger in New York
cn: 第 2 集 · 纽约最好吃的汉堡
novel:
Marshall [[remembered|remember]] a burger he ate eight years ago. It was [[legendary|legendary]] — the best burger in New York. He [[craved|crave]] it every day since, but he could not remember where the restaurant was. The [[quest|quest]] began.

The whole gang joined the [[hunt|hunt]]. They walked through dozens of blocks, checking every diner and burger joint. Marshall's [[nostalgia|nostalgia]] grew stronger with every bite of a [[mediocre|mediocre]] burger. "None of these are right," he [[declared|declare]].

Barney was [[skeptical|skeptical]]. "It's just a burger," he said. But Marshall [[insisted|insist]] that this burger was [[unmistakable|unmistakable]]. "The [[juicy|juicy]] meat, the [[crispy|crispy]] bun — it was perfect."

They finally found a [[clue|clue]]. A waitress remembered Marshall from years ago. She led them to a small restaurant with a [[sign|sign]] that read "The Best Burger."

Marshall took a bite. His eyes widened. "This is it," he [[whispered|whisper]]. The [[satisfaction|satisfaction]] on his face was [[genuine|genuine]].

Barney tried a bite and admitted it was good. "Not bad," he said, though his voice was less [[enthusiastic|enthusiastic]] than Marshall's.

As they left, Marshall felt a warmth inside. Some things from the past were worth searching for. The burger had [[haunted|haunt]] him for years, and now the memory was finally at peace.

remember.en: to keep something in your memory

hunt.en: an act of searching for something

nostalgia.en: a sad but warm feeling about the past

mediocre.en: not very good, not very bad

insist.en: to say firmly that something is true

juicy.en: full of juice, moist and tasty

crispy.en: firm and makes a sound when you bite it

clue.en: a piece of information that helps you find something

sign.en: a board with words on a shop

satisfaction.en: the good feeling when you get what you want

haunt.en: to keep coming back to your mind
